task_665f75d227ee049a24998b62.description: 2.1 Add the V2 block model matching `docs/prompt_compiler/schema/prompt_block_v2.schema.json`: `schemaVersion`, open `kind`, discriminated `placement`, `activation`, `priority`, `protection`, `provenance`, `extensions`

evidence.summary:
Added lib/src/models/prompt_block_v2.dart: PromptBlockV2 plus PromptBlockPlacementV2 / ActivationV2 / PriorityV2 / ProtectionV2 / ProvenanceV2, `schemaVersion: 2` stamped on toJson, open-string `kind`, and an `extensions` map. Exported from lib/starry_prompt_compiler.dart. dart analyze clean, package tests green.

ONE DELIBERATE DIVERGENCE FROM THIS TASK'S WORDING. The task says 'discriminated placement'. The shipped PromptBlockPlacementV2 is NOT discriminated: it carries anchor / injectionPosition / depth / injectionOrder as four nullable fields copied verbatim, with no `kind` discriminator and no `position` enum. That is what the CURRENT compat matrix section 4 specifies - the section was rewritten after the discriminated design was shown to be unsound (matrix section 4.4). The task text predates that rewrite. Building the discriminated union would have contradicted the spec it is supposed to implement.

Two convenience members are provided so call sites do not re-parse the namespace by hand: `kindName` strips the namespace, `isMarker` answers the one question V1's dropped boolean used to answer.

TWO DEVIATIONS FROM THIS TASK'S WORDING, both because the task predates the compat matrix rewrite:
1. 'section 4.1 the placement pattern table' - that table no longer exists. Section 4.1 is now a verbatim field copy. Implemented to the current spec.
2. 'section 4.2 the injectionOrder mirror rule' - now unconditional, not variant-gated. Implemented unconditionally.

NOT IMPLEMENTED: section 6 (config.sections). The task lists it, but that path belongs to the host's editor surface, not the compiler: PromptProfileResource.resolvedBlocks already falls back to config.toPromptBlocks() when blocks is empty, so a profile carrying only sections is converted to V1 blocks before it ever reaches this codec. Adding a second sections->V2 path here would create the duplicate conversion the flattening principle forbids. Recorded rather than silently skipped.

task_9e392fe56cf59359bc8e2b8a.description: 2.3 Unit-test the conversion: all 15 kinds, every placement pattern in §4.1, an unknown kind, an unknown JSON key, and a block with all five policy objects away from defaults. Assert `injectionOrder` is mirrored only for the four variants that admit it

evidence.summary:
test/prompt_block_v1_to_v2_test.dart, 18 cases, all green. Coverage against what this task asks for:

- ALL 15 KINDS: covered by iterating PromptBlockKind.values with expect(..., hasLength(15)) as a guard, so the coverage cannot silently shrink if a kind is added. Each asserts kind -> 'core:<name>', isCoreKind, and kindName.
- UNKNOWN KIND: a JSON kind of 'somethingNobodyDefined' decodes to PromptBlockKind.custom in V1 and therefore to 'core:custom' in V2 - asserted, not assumed. A separate case asserts an already-namespaced 'vendorx:thing' is NOT re-prefixed.
- UNKNOWN JSON KEY: preserved under extensions.legacy_v1; a companion case asserts the 11 known keys are NOT swept in; a third asserts an incoming isMarker is ignored rather than carried (section 5).
- ALL FIVE POLICY OBJECTS AWAY FROM DEFAULTS: one case sets id/promptProfileId/kind/name/enabled/content/role plus all five policy objects to non-default values and asserts each survives.
- PLACEMENT: 'verbatim copy' group asserts anchor survives byte-for-byte across 7 spellings including untrimmed '  AuthorNote  ' and mixed case, that a block with no policy yields all-null placement, that negative injectionPosition and depth survive, and that the single real fixture shape (A09's absolute+depth:1) round-trips.

DEVIATION, deliberate: the task says to assert injectionOrder is mirrored 'only for the four variants that admit it'. Those variants no longer exist - compat matrix section 4.2 now specifies an UNCONDITIONAL mirror, because with the discriminated union removed there is no block-local fact that could decide to omit it. The test therefore asserts the opposite of the task's literal wording: the mirror is present for all five anchor shapes tried (relative, absolute, history, authorNote, someOutlet), and null stays null on both sides. Asserting the task's wording would have pinned behaviour the current spec forbids.

task_1389e1361033dc2f4e43a2cb.description: 3.1 Change the planner to take V2 blocks, keeping every routing, ordering and filtering rule semantically unchanged

evidence.summary:
The planner now takes List<PromptBlockV2>. The grep for every V1 surface it used to touch returns ZERO hits: no PromptBlockKind, no placementPolicy / priorityPolicy / activationPolicy / protectionPolicy. Rewritten sites: _collectPromptBlockUnits, _blockInsertionMode, _resolveBlockTemplate, _promptMarkerOrders, _isHistoryMarker, _markerIdentityForBlock, _isMandatoryPromptBlock, _comparePromptBlocks, _budgetTierForBlock, _anchorIdForBlock, _defaultMarkerForBlock.

EVERY ROUTING/ORDERING/FILTERING RULE IS UNCHANGED, and two spots needed care to keep it that way:
1. V1 `placementPolicy.anchor` is non-nullable defaulting to 'relative'; V2 `placement.anchor` is nullable where null means 'no policy was set'. Both read sites use `?? 'relative'`, preserving the exact V1 reading.
2. `_defaultMarkerForBlock` switched from a closed enum to an open String, so the `custom => null` arm became a `_ => null` wildcard. Without it the switch is non-exhaustive - the analyzer caught this, it was not spotted by eye.

Enum equality became namespaced string equality ('core:postHistoryInstructions', 'core:chatHistory', 'core:systemPrompt'); the three `switch (block.kind)` sites switch on `block.kindName` so the arms stay the bare V1 spellings.

Proof that behaviour did not move: the 22-fixture golden gate is 44/44 with the manifest hash unchanged at 245D64AFF6F82FFB7ECDA4683A4438492424DF1499EF96EA0C41032FD08DDE02 - same value as the pre-migration baseline. dart analyze clean; dart test 208 passed (190 baseline + 18 new).

Post-migration golden run in Starry-Flutter-Frontend: 44/44 passed, exit 0. Byte-identity manifest recomputed and still 245D64AFF6F82FFB7ECDA4683A4438492424DF1499EF96EA0C41032FD08DDE02, so none of the 22 expectations moved. Fixture tree and test/goldens/ both clean under git status --porcelain AND git diff --stat HEAD.

task_dff8ed2404b1323fab03f2ba.description: 4.2 Confirm no expectation was modified: `git status --porcelain` and `git diff --stat HEAD` both clean for the fixture tree and `test/goldens/`

evidence.summary:
Both criteria empty for both trees, in Starry-Flutter-Frontend after the migration and the golden run.

git status --porcelain over test/fixtures/starry_prompt_compiler/behavior_v1 and test/goldens/: NO output. git diff --stat HEAD over the same two paths: NO output.

Why both and not just the first: status alone can be silenced by an ignore rule, so a written file could hide behind .gitignore and look clean. diff --stat HEAD compares against the commit and does not consult ignore rules for tracked files. Agreement between the two is what rules out a silent rewrite - this pairing is a standing requirement in this codebase precisely because a golden runner that writes on mismatch has burned it before.

Third, independent check: the SHA256 manifest of all 22 expected.json (aggregate 245D64AF...DE02) is unchanged across pre-migration, post-migration and post-format. Content-addressed, so it does not depend on git's view at all.
evidence.command: git status --porcelain test/fixtures/starry_prompt_compiler/behavior_v1 test/goldens ; git diff --stat HEAD -- test/fixtures/starry_prompt_compiler/behavior_v1 test/goldens

The antecedent is FALSE - zero fixtures differ (4.1: 44/44, 4.2: both git criteria empty, manifest 245D64AF...DE02 stable across three captures). There is therefore no difference to record, and the stop condition did not fire. The conversion is proven, so sections 5 and 6 are not blocked BY THIS GATE.

IMPORTANT, so nobody misreads the pending state below it: sections 5 and 6 are nevertheless staying pending, for a reason entirely outside this task's scope. Deleting the V1 path changes the PERSISTED block kind from 'custom' to 'core:custom'. V1 PromptBlock is the payload type of promptBlockResourceDescriptor (prompt_block_payload_codec.dart:153 in Starry-Flutter-Frontend, registered at authoring_providers.dart:46), whose encode() writes 'kind': payload.kind.name straight into a Drift payload blob, and whose schema is currentVersion: 1 with an EMPTY upgrades map. Every already-stored row would decode to PayloadReadFailed - real user data loss. That makes step 4 a data migration requiring the PayloadSchema ring-fence to be lifted, which is the user's call and has been explicitly withheld. Full chain recorded in _agent_logs/G4-v1-deletion-is-a-data-migration.md. This is 'not authorised yet', not 'not finished'.
